properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign JWT tokens (minimum 32 characters).

properties.name: app.jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: JWT token expiration time in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.mail.mock
properties.description: When true, email sending is mocked (no real SMTP calls).

properties.name: app.frontend-url
properties.description: Base URL of the frontend application, used for CORS and redirect links.
